body.html: Lampang Residence is at 136/98 Phaholyothin Road, Sop Tui, Mueang Lampang · what guests mention most is its central location near the Lampang bus terminal and Nakhon Lampang railway station, close to Central Plaza Lampang, its roomy clean rooms and easy access · it's a 49-room stay. Travelers arriving by coach or train, drivers passing through for a night, or anyone wanting a roomy, clean room near the mall on a budget tend to choose it, because you step out of the hotel and reach the bus terminal, railway station and Central Plaza in just a few minutes.

What guests agree on most is that the rooms are roomy, clean and good value · many reviews say rooms are larger than expected for a high-hundreds rate, around 45 sq m, with comfy beds, cold air-con, working hot water, a fridge and tea/coffee in the room · room types run from a King to a Twin with two beds, many have a balcony and some look out to mountain views · guests say getting a roomy, clean room with breakfast in this central location at this price stands out for Lampang.
"The room was very spacious and clean, the bed was comfortable, it had a balcony, the staff were friendly and helped with tips and transport, close to the bus terminal and Central — great value."

The other thing guests love about Lampang Residence is its friendly staff and attentive service · many reviews praise the team as warm, clear in their explanations, happy to recommend places to visit and to help arrange transfers · there's an on-site restaurant, a garden, a terrace and a small fitness room · an American-style breakfast is included, a simple buffet with Thai rice soup, sticky rice with grilled pork skewers and easy options · free on-site parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk and round-the-clock security make late arrivals and early starts easy.

Now for the location, honestly, as it's both a plus and a limit · it sits in the Sop Tui area on the bus-terminal and railway-station side, near Central Plaza Lampang, which is very handy for coach and train arrivals and mall trips, but it isn't in the Kad Kong Ta old-town quarter · from the hotel it's about 5–10 minutes' drive into Kad Kong Ta and the old town, and on to Wat Phra That Lampang Luang · the upside is easy access in and out of town and to the mall, but if you want to walk the old town in the evening you'll need a car or to call a ride · the cool season (November–February) is Lampang's high season and rooms fill fast, so book ahead.

Now for the honest part: this is a simple, budget-friendly stay rather than a full-facility hotel · reviews commonly note there's no swimming pool, and breakfast is on the simple side, so some guests would like more choice · it's a residence-style building where rooms are roomy and clean rather than designed, and some reviews say parts look plain rather than modern · because it sits on a main road, some rooms may catch street noise, so light sleepers should ask for an inner room · overall it's about roomy clean rooms, a near-the-terminal location and value rather than luxury.

Overall, Lampang Residence is about roomy clean rooms, a central location near the bus terminal and good value rather than an old-town walking location or a resort with a pool · it suits travelers arriving by coach or train, drivers, and anyone wanting a clean, roomy room near the bus terminal and Central Plaza on a budget with breakfast included · if you want to sleep in the old town within walking distance of Kad Kong Ta, or a riverside resort with a pool, this isn't the answer · but if what you want is a roomy clean room, a comfy bed, a spot near the terminal and the mall, easy parking, friendly staff and breakfast at a budget price — it does that job, and does it for real value.

A tip from those who follow the reviews here: if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room away from the main road, and if you want a bright room with a view, ask for one with a balcony or mountain view · since it's near the bus terminal and railway station, it works well as a base for coach and train arrivals, but for an evening walk around Kad Kong Ta you'll want a car or a ride arranged · book ahead in the cool season as it's high season, and compare a few platforms first, as breakfast-included rates can differ.

If you expect a full-facility hotel or a pool — this is a simple, budget-friendly stay with no pool; its strength is roomy clean rooms near the terminal → for a pool or resort feel, look at the Wang River-side properties instead.

faq.q: Where is Lampang Residence and what's nearby?
faq.a: Lampang Residence is at 136/98 Phaholyothin Road, Sop Tui, Mueang Lampang, in central Lampang on the bus-terminal side · it's about 1.3 km from the Lampang bus terminal and Nakhon Lampang railway station, and close to Central Plaza Lampang · about 5–10 minutes' drive into Kad Kong Ta and the old town · about 10 minutes to Lampang Airport.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿700/night with breakfast for a Standard King · options run from a Standard Twin and a mountain-view King Room with a balcony up to a Family Room for groups · cool-season rates (Nov–Feb) rise and rooms fill quickly as it's Lampang's high season, so compare a few platforms first as breakfast-included rates can differ.

faq.q: Who is Lampang Residence best for?
faq.a: It's best for travelers arriving by coach or train, drivers, or anyone wanting a roomy, clean stay near the bus terminal and Central Plaza on a budget with breakfast · it works well as a one-night stopover or a base for exploring Lampang · it's less suited to those after an old-town walking location near Kad Kong Ta, or a resort with a pool.

faq.q: What are the rooms and atmosphere like at Lampang Residence?
faq.a: The highlights are roomy rooms around 45 sq m, clean, with comfy beds, a balcony and friendly staff · rooms have air-con, TV, fridge, tea/coffee and a private shower bathroom, with mountain views in some · there's an on-site restaurant, garden, terrace, fitness room and a 24-hour front desk · an American-style breakfast is included.

faq.q: What should I know before staying at Lampang Residence?
faq.a: Reviews note that it's in the Sop Tui area on the bus-terminal side, not the Kad Kong Ta old town, and there's no swimming pool · it's a simple, budget-friendly stay where breakfast is on the simple side · it's a residence-style building focused on roomy clean rooms rather than design, and because it's on a main road some rooms may catch street noise — light sleepers should ask for an inner room.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and is cancellation possible?
faq.a: In the cool season (November–February), book several weeks ahead, as it's Lampang's high season and with only 49 rooms it fills fast · at other times a few days is usually enough · every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm, and compare a few platforms before booking.
